home.tagline: Amingad sheep, raised in our sheds.
home.lead: We raise Amingad (Yelaga) sheep in clean sheds, fed on time and watched every day. Visit the farm, see each sheep, and pick the one you want.
home.availableEmpty: No sheep listed right now. Call us to ask about the next batch.
home.why1: Pure Amingad (Yelaga) breed, known in north Karnataka for hardy, well-built sheep.
home.why2: Raised in sheds, not open-grazed — fed on time, kept clean and checked daily.
home.why3: Every sheep is listed with its weight and price, so you know before you visit.
home.visitText: Sontenahalli, near Bengaluru. Please call or WhatsApp before you visit.

about.title: About the farm
about.p1: Varsha Farms is a family sheep farm in Sontenahalli, near Bengaluru, run by Raju S T.
about.name: Varsha means rain — the season every farmer waits for.
about.p2: Amingad sheep, called Yelaga locally, come from north Karnataka. They are hardy, medium-sized animals, valued for meat and for breeding.
about.p3: Our sheep are not sent out to graze. They live in raised sheds, get fodder and water on time, and are looked at every day. This keeps them clean, calm and growing steadily.
about.p4: You are welcome to come and see the sheep, and to watch them being weighed. Call or WhatsApp Raju to fix a time.
contact.title: Call, WhatsApp or visit
contact.lead: Raju answers calls and WhatsApp messages. Please call before visiting the farm.
